data.name: Howie
data.long_meaning: The name Howie is derived from the Old English word hugh, which means 'heart, mind, and spirit'. In Anglo-Saxon culture, Howie signified a wise and brave individual. The name gained popularity in the English-speaking world during the Middle Ages.
